product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides an operating system and fleet-management software for enterprise and government teams to run AI-powered drones and autonomous robots.

pricing_page.notes: The Auterion Suite page presents plans and links to a downloadable pricing document.

named_customers.notes: Both are explicitly identified as customers.

hq_location.notes: Auterion also lists a European headquarters in Munich, Germany.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored posts explain collision-prevention algorithms and visual-inertial navigation implementation.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index includes application development, sensor data, SDK APIs, hardware integration and fleet management.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Computer Vision Engineer opening is listed in Manassas, Virginia.

model_provider.notes: Auterion publicly supports deploying Spleenlab’s machine-learning perception software on AI Node; this is an optional integration, not a disclosed universal dependency or LLM provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Auterion’s terms explicitly state GDPR compliance; this is a compliance claim, not an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 23, 2025, led by Bessemer Venture Partners.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 Series B falls within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable job board lists openings, but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced the Nemyx Vertical Launch System on October 5, 2026, within the requested May 9–November 9 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lorin Metzger’s profile lists a December 2025 start as Vice President of Advanced Programs & Software, US, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The RevOps Manager posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as part of the company’s GTM stack.
